CommunityApplications.Profile:
**NASearch** — a lightweight, self-hosted file search UI for your Unraid array.
Powered by `plocate`, it indexes your entire array in seconds and delivers instant, browser-based search across millions of files.
**Rich previews** — images, video (with seek), audio, PDF, rendered Markdown, interactive 3D STL models (WebGL), and ZIP contents — all inline in the browser.
**Folder browsing** — explore directory trees from any search result; download files or whole folders as ZIPs.
**Secure login** — session-cookie authentication with CSRF protection and rate limiting.
**Themes & customisation** — dark, purple, slate, and light themes; custom colour palette; optional scanline overlay.
**Auto-indexing** — configurable scheduler (1 h to 7 days) or manual trigger with live progress.
No Elasticsearch. No Node. No build step. One container, one volume.
For support and bug reports, please open an issue on GitHub.
